source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2 ("Moira: Ballyleny"); Irish News, 2 June 1967, p. 1
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Read on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2: 'BALLYLENY - Mr. Victor Mathers (Unaffiliated Unionist) 297; Mr. Noel Wickie (Official Unionist) 190. Majority 107' (297 - 190 = 107); the Irish News of the same day, p. 1, prints the same figures. The Belfast Telegraph's rural round-up (2 June 1967, p. 8), cited before, has no Moira result.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Ballyleny was the only contest; the other divisions were filled unopposed. First local election in the division for 50 years; Mathers (unaffiliated Unionist) beat the official Unionist by 107 votes.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the result is now cited to the pages that print it (was the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, whose round-up omits Moira); names and votes unchanged, printed majority 107 recorded.
